scene nightsky
After that, the night refuses to end.
Though, I suppose it would be a bit more accurate to say that two of us would be extremely irresponsible if we let it.
For, just as expected of a woman who ordered two bottles of wine, Haruka leaves the restaurant in a state of disrepair- and it falls on Molly and me to make sure she gets home safely.
It would have been simple to leave her lying there in the gutter, but then two of my students would be without jobs in the morning and my chance of co-owning a coffee shop would be all but null.
So, instead of allowing her to follow in the footsteps of that one poet who paraphrased that one politician that I told you about years and years ago- we return her to her rightful place.
But that place is wrong for the rest of us.
scene mollyharukahome1
: I’ll have...one more glass of...chardonnay, please!
: That item is on cooldown. You will have a cold shower and flask of sobriety. Which is also known as coffee — a thing I am assuming you have in your home based on your profession.
scene mollyharukahome2
: Molly...do you...hic...think I’m pretty?...
: Right now, the only thing I can think of is how regretful I am to have ever stooped to your current level in the past.
: Because I think you’re pretty! And I think everyone who doesn’t want to have sex with you is hic...a fucking loser!
: That’s somewhat reassuring as it would mean the amount of losers in our class greatly surpasses just me.
: Lessgo...to my room...and I’ll make a...hic...real woman outta ya...
: Have fun, Molly. I’ll wait out here.
scene mollyharukahome3
: As if I’d take her up on that! I’m playing the light path on this run and taking advantage of women in a drunken stupor is something only Dark Molly would do!
: Also, why do I have to be the one carrying her?! Your level is much higher than mine and, need I remind you, I main a healer!
: Reminding me of things I don’t really get isn’t going to do much. Also, it’s safer if you’re the one carrying Haruka based on...prior history I have with her in that state.
: Sir...you didn’t.
scene mollyharukahome4
: Your teacher’s a...really good kisser, you know! You should try it!
: But...your husband-
scene mollyharukahome5
: Let’s all make out on my bed! I volunteer to teach Molly! And it won’t be illegal because I’m her boss!
: I can’t believe I skipped out on watching anime for this.
scene mollyharukahome6
: Stop pretending you’re not hic... a little interested when our hic...boobs have been touching this whole time!
: I...have noticed.
: She’s not going to stop until she gets some sleep, just to let you know. No amount of coffee or cold showers can force the horny out of Haruka.
scene mollyharukahome7
: Sir, you and the Magistrate may both have several years on me, but I can assure you my knowledge of “the horny” far surpasses my age.
: I have several addictions I am not very proud of.
: It’s a little more than several years, but thank you for not making me feel as old as everyone else does.
: Now, go put your horny boss to bed before our bonus CG is one that we’ll look back on with regret.
scene mollyharukahome8
: T’at’s what I’m feckin’ tryin’ ta’ do and all ye’ve done ta’ help’s sit around wit’ ‘yer cock in yer hands!
: Don’t get Irish with me, young lady. You have a job to do.
scene mollyharukahome9
: Fackin’...Haruka! Move ‘yer arse! Ye’ know it’s serious when even Molly MacCormack has had enough of the games!
: Are you suuuuuure you don’t wanna mess around with me? I won’t tell anybody! It’ll be a hic... lil’ secret!
: Yes! The quest ends at droppin’ you off in bed! There ain’t any more to it!
: Not even if I got a free Sybian from Maki last moooooonth~
: I don’t care about ‘yer feckin’-
scene mollyharukahome10
: Wait...really?
: Want me to...hic... teach you how to ride it?...
: Weeeeeeell?...
scene mollyharukahome11
: Gah! Yes! But you’re still drunk as all Hell and I’m apparently the responsible one tonight, so I can’t!
: I wouldn’t mind a referral to this Maki person, though! I have more than enough open slots in my friends list for a connection like that!
scene black
: Sir, wait out ‘ere. Lord knows what’ll happen next if ya follow the two of us into the Magistrate’s lair.
: See, this is exactly why I wasn’t helping you. I’m glad you finally understand.
Molly somehow manages to get Haruka moving again and I head into the living room to wait out...whatever it is that’s going to happen in her bedroom.
And while I absolutely do want to follow them in there-
scene lavendersgreen28
it is for the best that i don’t
scene mollyharukahome12
: Christ almighty, it’s like heroic Spine all over again.
: I’ve led my share of cracked out parties in the day, but this may have just been my greatest challenge yet.
: S...Sybian...
scene mollyharukahome13
: Drink ‘yer water, damn it! That’s twice ‘ye made me look like a buffoon in front of the Herald tonight!
: Why don’t you just...hic...go for it if you want him so bad? There’s no harm in trying, is there?
scene mollyharukahome14
: Hah...
: ‘Tis true that Sir probably wouldn’t hold it against me if I did, but things are a bit more complicated than that.
: Complicated...shmomplicated...You wanna fuck him, don’t you? Be honest...
: Have toyed with the idea of experimenting with him. But it was he who planted that idea in my head.
: What’s the problem then?...Just do it...You can even use my couch if you want...
scene mollyharukahome15
: I think that zeppelin may have already departed.
scene mollyharukahome16
: Yeah, well...there’s Greta Van Fleet now, so...
: I’m...still not fully over Rin. But I’m moving on now, and it’s true that I am interested in the Supreme Overlord...it’s just...
: I don’t think he’s interested in me. In fact, I know he’s not interested in me as he still can’t hold eye contact the way he used to.
: He’s never been good at that to begin with, but ever since that Halloween it’s just...
: Do you think we can ever go back, Haruka?
: Do you think it’s possible for a relationship that was so damaged to be repaired when you’ve still not even figured out the true cause of that damage?
: All my gold goes to PNGs and I’m running out of resources to tackle this never-ending repair bill.
: Some nights, I think it might be better to just swap sets entirely. Maybe use cloth armor or something.
: Other nights, I think of trying a whole new game entirely.
: But there’s one person I keep wantin’ to play with and that person just...
: Doesn’t like games.
: Or me.
: You’re asleep, aren’t you?
: Just......like that.........Tsuneyo.....
scene mollyharukahome17
: Um...what?
: It’s okay...you can bite it, baby...it won’t hurt me...
scene black
: Okay! That’s enough of that. What happens in my boss’s room stays in my boss’s room and I never heard any of it.
scene mollyharukahome18
: Hah...
: I’d seen her drunk before, but never like that. That was just a step or two away from “A Night to Remember” level tomfoolery.
: Well, based on what I assume Haruka said to you in there, I have a hard time believing this is a night you’ll soon forget.
: It likely wasn’t what you think, Sir. Her sexual propositioning of me stopped once I laid her down.
scene mollyharukahome19
: Yeah...I’m more or less talking about what I expect she said to you after her propositioning ended.
: Sir?
: Sir, you can talk to me. I hope you know that.
: Am I really the...next in line or whatever?
: Next in line?...Are you referring to what Haruka said at dinner?
: And probably again behind closed doors just a few minutes ago.
: I know her pretty well at this point. She’s more gung-ho about me banging teenagers than even I am sometimes.
scene mollyharukahome20
: You mean...other teenagers.
: Not me.
: I should be the last person in whatever that line is, Molly. We both know that.
: Except we don’t.
: And every time we’ve tried talking about it, we’ve settled on how we don’t. Which is precisely why I’m so confused, Sir.
: Granted, I was confused before any of this even began. And you were close enough to catch onto that confusion and offer to help me learn things about myself I’d been nervous about learning.
: Is that why you like me so much? Because I’m close?
scene mollyharukahome21
: Not at all, Sir. You’re not at the front of the line for showing up earlier than anyone else- you’re at the front of the line for caring about me and appreciating me in ways no one else has.
: Tsuneyo appreciates you. The rest of the manga club appreciates you. And even if things are weird with Rin, I’m sure she appreciates you on some level as well.
: But none of those people ever took advantage of you while you were unconscious in a dark room.
: Stop going back to that.
: It’s over.
: Sir, if you’re not attracted to me, just say it. I’ve had trouble accepting that in the past, but the context this time is obvious enough that I won’t be able to blow it off again.
: That’s not the problem, Molly.
scene mollyharukahome22
: Then what is it that makes me different from everyone else?
: I ask this not just as someone who wants to be closer to you, but as someone who has always been different in the first place.
: Is it my interests or hobbies that make me undesirable? Is it my hair? My skin?
: I need to know these things so if I ever do decide to pursue romance with a real human being, I’ll understand what sticks out the most.
: It’s me. I’m the problem.
: That’s a cop-out answer the protagonist gives to a side character who didn’t make it onto the box art. What is the real one?
: Do you...
: Do you still want to help me experiment, Sir?
: Because Haruka won’t be waking up for a long time and- can you please look at me when I’m speaking seriously with you?
: My moments of true maturity are rare...but they exist, Sir. And this is one of them.
: Just...pick someone else who's less capable of hurting you.
scene mollyharukahome23
: It is I who chooses what does and does not hurt me, Sir. Not you.
: I may be a frail Irish lass who burns after five minutes of exposure to the sun, yes-
: But I’m the daughter of a single parent, who experienced loss in the worst way possible...Who’s lived her whole, albeit very short life as both an outcast and the center of attention everywhere.
: I may hide away in fiction from time to time because it makes things easier, but I’m strong enough to survive on the outside when I need to.
: Let what happened in the dark stay there...It doesn’t matter if it was the worst thing possible or nothing at all.
: Because, Sir...and this is embarrassing to admit...but if I were to walk into a room just like that today...there is no one I would rather have follow me in than you.
: Or maybe Felicia Day.
: I don’t know who that is.
: Sir, answer me honestly-
: If I were to make a move right now, how would you react?
: Because I’m going to.
: And this is the part where you make a decision that changes the rest of our relationship.
: Molly...
: How will you react?
menu:
Rape her
scene mollyharukahome24
: I think you should sleep here tonight. I can’t walk you home.
: Sir! Wait! You don’t have to leave! You can just say no!
: You never got to say no.
scene mollyharukahome25
: It’s okay if you’re uncomfortable! I just wanted to know if-
: Goodnight, Molly.
: Sir...
scene mollyharukahome26
: Tch...
: Damn it...Damn it, damn it, damn it...
: Can’t you see this is exactly what I meant when I put you before everyone else?...
: As if any of the others would ever look that way for me...
scene black
: Why do humans have to be so hard?...
scene park_night
: She didn’t mean that.
: She’s confused.
: She doesn’t know what she wants.
: She’s just a hormonal teenage girl.
scene black
: But if that’s true...
: What is it that makes the others different?
I try to fall asleep on a park bench, but I keep thinking of Molly.
I think about how Molly wants me.
I think about what I want to do to her.
But for some strange reason-
I still want to run away.
scene bedroom_night
The hook under my desk reels me back to safety and I don’t have to run at all.
I end the night by jerking off into an orange sock.
